host.description: The hostname or address of the mysql server

port.description: The port to use for connecting to the mysql server

database.description: The name of the database to use. Required if you are not using the "Execute Query" Action

markdown.description:
**DO NOT** use dynamic input directly in the query string or column names.
  

  Use **?** in the query and dynamic values in args/values for parameterized queries to prevent **SQL injection**.

timezone.description: Timezone for the MySQL server to use

condition.description: SQL condition, can also include logic operators, etc.

args.description: Arguments can be used using ? in the condition

columns.description: Specify the columns you want to select

aiMetadata.description: Reads rows from a MySQL table that match a SQL WHERE condition, optionally limited to specific columns. Use to look up or filter records by arbitrary criteria. The condition is required and is interpolated raw into the query, so pass dynamic values through the args array (referenced as ? placeholders) to avoid SQL injection. Read-only and idempotent.

insert_row.name: insert_row
insert_row.description: Inserts a new row into a table

timezone.description: Timezone for the MySQL server to use

aiMetadata.description: Inserts a new row into a MySQL table from a map of column names to values. Use to add a record. Not idempotent: each call performs a fresh INSERT, so repeating it adds duplicate rows (or errors on a unique-key collision).

update_row.name: update_row
update_row.description: Updates one or more rows in a table

timezone.description: Timezone for the MySQL server to use

aiMetadata.description: Updates every row in a MySQL table whose search column equals a given value, setting the supplied column-to-value pairs. Use to modify existing records matched by a single column. Idempotent: re-running with the same input writes the same values and has no additional effect.

delete_row.name: delete_row
delete_row.description: Deletes one or more rows from a table

markdown.description:
**DO NOT** use dynamic input directly in the query string or column names.
  

  Use **?** in the query and dynamic values in args/values for parameterized queries to prevent **SQL injection**.

timezone.description: Timezone for the MySQL server to use

aiMetadata.description: Deletes every row in a MySQL table whose search column equals a given value. Use to remove records matched by a single column. Idempotent: once the matching rows are gone, re-running with the same input deletes nothing further.

get_tables.name: get_tables
get_tables.description: Returns a list of tables in the database

aiMetadata.description: Lists the names of all tables in the connected MySQL database (SHOW TABLES). Use to discover the schema before reading or writing rows. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

execute_query.name: execute_query
execute_query.description: Executes a query on the mysql database and returns the results

markdown.description:
**DO NOT** use dynamic input directly in the query string or column names.
  

  Use **?** in the query and dynamic values in args/values for parameterized queries to prevent **SQL injection**.

timezone.description: Timezone for the MySQL server to use

query.description: The query string to execute, use ? for arguments to avoid SQL injection.

args.description: Arguments to use in the query, if any. Should be in the same order as the ? in the query string..

aiMetadata.description: Runs an arbitrary SQL statement against the MySQL database and returns its results. Use as the escape hatch when the dedicated find/insert/update/delete actions cannot express the operation (joins, DDL, multi-table writes, aggregates). Pass dynamic values through the args array as ? placeholders to avoid SQL injection. Not idempotent in general: the effect and repeat-safety depend entirely on the SQL you supply (a SELECT is safe to repeat, an INSERT or UPDATE may not be).
